text: Automated retraining for a production Amazon Bedrock classifier that rates research documents by importance: on an EventBridge schedule a larger LLM grades its ratings, and fine-tuning runs only when the grades shift past a threshold
decisive_wording: B: "Automated retraining for a production classifier on Amazon Bedrock that rates research documents by importance, using a larger LLM as a judge" vs A: "Built LLM-as-a-judge gating for a production Amazon Bedrock document-importance classifier" and C: "a larger LLM grades its ratings"
info: All three keep the same facts: production Bedrock classifier, document importance, larger LLM evaluator, EventBridge schedule, threshold-gated fine-tuning. B and C add 'research documents' and frame the outcome as 'automated retraining', which A leaves implicit behind 'gating'. C drops the recognizable term 'LLM as a judge' (replaced by 'grades'), losing a keyword that matches job postings; A and B keep it.
